categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of OLED organic materials, including OLED terminal materials and intermediates. It also operates subsidiaries involved in OLED intermediate and pharmaceutical intermediate materials production and sales. The business focuses on electronic special materials manufacturing, particularly OLED organic materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced OLED organic material synthesis, purification, and device fabrication technologies, including vacuum evaporation and sublimation purification. It has developed proprietary technologies for high-efficiency red, green, and blue phosphorescent materials, hole transport layers, electron transport layers, and tandem device materials. The company integrates AI and machine learning in its R&D processes and maintains a full industry chain from intermediate synthesis to device evaluation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic OLED panel manufacturers such as BOE, Tianma, Huaxing Optoelectronics, and Xinli. The end markets served are consumer electronics including smartphones, tablets, laptops, automotive displays, and wearable devices. The company’s materials are used in products from brands like Huawei, Honor, OPPO, and VIVO.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. It also serves overseas markets through partnerships with international customers and has patent protections in China, the US, Japan, Korea, and Europe. Overseas sales constitute a smaller but growing portion of revenue.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream and midstream in the OLED supply chain, producing core OLED organic materials and intermediates supplied to panel manufacturers. It has an integrated production model covering OLED intermediates, sublimation materials, and terminal materials, supporting downstream panel production and end product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in OLED organic materials, focusing on red, green, and blue phosphorescent materials, tandem device materials, and TADF materials. The company invests heavily in R&D, leveraging AI and machine learning for material design and process optimization. It also pursues patent portfolio expansion and collaborates with universities and industry leaders to advance next-generation OLED technologies and explore new materials like perovskites.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of OLED organic materials and intermediates to panel manufacturers and other industrial customers. The company uses a direct sales model based on customer orders, with revenue recognized upon delivery and transfer of control. It also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic OLED organic material supplier, recognized for breaking foreign patent monopolies and achieving domestic substitution. It competes with international material suppliers and domestic peers, maintaining strong partnerships with major panel makers. It holds a significant market share in China and is positioned as a technology leader with a comprehensive patent portfolio and integrated production capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 471.77 million, a 56.9% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 167.32 million, up 117.17%. R&D investment accounted for 13.71% of revenue. The company’s total assets reached RMB 2.12 billion, with steady growth in net assets and cash flow from operations. It has demonstrated strong profitability and cash generation with ongoing capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, patented OLED organic materials with performance metrics at or above international standards. It offers a diversified product portfolio covering all core OLED functional layers, enabling domestic substitution of imported materials. Its integrated supply chain and close customer collaboration ensure stable supply, rapid innovation, and tailored solutions. The company’s strong IP protection and advanced R&D capabilities provide a competitive moat and support sustainable growth.
